(2) The bounds-check mask xmask = xindex < xnumel adds predicated loads/stores and comparison instructions for every element, inflating executed instructions from 18M to 54M (3x). Since xnumel=19267584 is divisible by 128 (and all candidate XBLOCK values), the mask is always True and can be eliminated. (3) The main load tl.load(in_out_ptr0 + x3, xmask) accesses contiguous memory but lacks tl.max_contiguous/tl.multiple_of hints, preventing the compiler from emitting 128-bit vectorized (LDG.128) loads. Fixing the grid lambda enables autotune to actually explore larger XBLOCK values, removing the mask eliminates 3x instruction bloat, and adding alignment hints enables 128-bit vectorized loads to reduce L1TEX stall cycles.
